objective: Measure redundant tool schema exposure in primary model context for plan vs build and test safe mode-aware context tool catalog gating; no chat-history truncation or prompt rewrite.

revisions.upstream_api: anomalyco/opencode packages/plugin/src/effect/session.ts commit aa2960fa266e898cf4d0bf0cd1c86beed23e3591 (source inspection, version match not proven)

hypotheses.observation: For bound repo project sessions, workspacePlugin context hook removes global workspace tools but retains unusable linux and generic github in 'plan' agent; plan can instead use inspect_linux and repo_* aliases.
hypotheses.intervention: At session context hook, for agent==='plan' remove linux tool and redundant generic github ONLY if repo_read, repo_info and repo_review are present. Keep builds unchanged; preserve real execution authorization.
hypotheses.prediction: At least 15% fewer serialized model-facing tool schema UTF8 bytes in plan+bound-repo fixture, no missing authorized capabilities or changes to other scopes.
hypotheses.falsification: <15% schema byte reduction, missing repo_read/info/review or inspect_linux, change to build/unscoped contexts, or change to execution security

environment: GitHub Actions bun@1.4.4 fake plugin context runtime; actual workspacePlugin setup and createPiTools declarations. No LLM, no provider, no paid cloud inference.

metrics.schemaUtf8Bytes: bytes (UTF8 JSON.stringify actual tool descriptions and input schemas exposed through plugin context hook)
metrics.availablePermissions: capability names + existing runtime permission guard checks
metrics.elapsedMs: ms perf.now around plugin context hook

thresholds.security: no permission changes; no newly accessible tools

evidence_plan.baselineRows: GitHub CI log captured and archived
evidence_plan.pairedRows: GitHub CI log captured and archived; test records begin/end per case
evidence_plan.backups: PR draft branch only, no deployments

stop_rule: Partial validation of schema-byte reduction or inconclusive if hook inaccessible; do not claim token cost savings absent provider usage telemetry.
